ClipboardMenu.title.sharing.message: Clipboard sharing is on. Text and images you copy on your computer reach the guest, and text and images copied in the guest reach your computer.
ClipboardMenu.title.sharing.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's clipboard button (shown while the running machine shares the clipboard), while it shares and nothing limits it.

ClipboardMenu.title.limited.message: Clipboard sharing is on. Until this web app may see the clipboard, the guest gets what you copy on your computer only when you paste with the keyboard while the guest's screen has the focus, not from the guest's own menus.
ClipboardMenu.title.limited.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's clipboard button while it shares but the browser hasn't allowed reading the clipboard (asked or blocked), or the reads stopped (ClipboardMenu.stopped). The button has a mark then.

ClipboardMenu.title.paused.message: Clipboard sharing is paused. Nothing passes between the guest and your computer until you resume it or the machine starts again.
ClipboardMenu.title.paused.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's clipboard button while the user paused the sharing (its icon crossed out). The pause lasts until the machine starts again.

ClipboardMenu.title.waiting.message: Clipboard sharing is waiting for this emulator's program in the guest. It starts once the guest has booted, if the guest is running systemd version 256 or above.
ClipboardMenu.title.waiting.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's clipboard button, and a note in its menu, while the guest's program isn't there: before it started, or since it stopped.

ClipboardMenu.allow.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: its first item while the browser hasn't decided whether this web app may read the clipboard. A click makes the browser ask.

ClipboardMenu.allow.title.message: Ask this browser to let this web app see the clipboard, so that the guest can paste what you copy on your computer from its own menus too.
ClipboardMenu.allow.title.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: tooltip of ClipboardMenu.allow.

ClipboardMenu.denied.message: This browser doesn't let this web app see the clipboard, so the guest gets what you copy on your computer only when you paste with the keyboard while the guest's screen has the focus. To allow it, click the icon at the left of the address bar, and allow Clipboard in the site's settings.
ClipboardMenu.denied.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note at its top while the browser blocks reading the clipboard (the user said no, or the site's settings block it).

ClipboardMenu.granted.message: This web app may see the clipboard. What you copy on your computer reaches the guest when you reopen this web app.
ClipboardMenu.granted.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note at its top while the browser allows reading the clipboard.

ClipboardMenu.stopped.message: This browser gave this web app empty text several times while the clipboard held text, so the guest no longer gets what you copy when you reopen this web app. Paste with the keyboard while the guest's screen has the focus instead, or use Send the clipboard to the guest. This lasts until the machine starts again.
ClipboardMenu.stopped.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note while the reads made each time the page gets the focus back stopped for the run, because the browser or the computer's system hid the clipboard's text from them (macOS can).

ClipboardMenu.share.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: the box that is ticked while the clipboard is shared; unticking it pauses the sharing until the machine starts again.

ClipboardMenu.share.title.message: Untick to pause the sharing in both directions until the machine starts again, for example before you copy a password.
ClipboardMenu.share.title.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: tooltip of ClipboardMenu.share.

ClipboardMenu.send.message: Send the clipboard to the guest
ClipboardMenu.send.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: button that gives the guest's clipboard what is on the computer's clipboard now (the browser may ask first).

ClipboardMenu.send.title.message: Put what you copied on your computer on the guest's clipboard now.
ClipboardMenu.send.title.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: tooltip of ClipboardMenu.send.

ClipboardMenu.type.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: button that pastes the computer's clipboard on the guest's text console (the browser may ask first).

ClipboardMenu.type.title.message: Paste what you copied on your computer at the guest's text console, as if typed.
ClipboardMenu.type.title.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: tooltip of ClipboardMenu.type.

ClipboardMenu.screen.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: button that puts a picture of the guest's screen (what the page shows of it) on the computer's clipboard, as an image. It works without the guest's program.

ClipboardMenu.screen.title.message: Put a picture of the guest's screen on your computer's clipboard, as an image you can paste in other programs.
ClipboardMenu.screen.title.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: tooltip of ClipboardMenu.screen.

ClipboardMenu.screen.failed.message: The screen wasn't copied. There may have been no video output yet, or this web app ran into a browser limitation.
ClipboardMenu.screen.failed.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note after Copy the screen failed (the guest hadn't shown anything yet, or the browser refused the write).

ClipboardMenu.console.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: button that puts the text the guest's text console shows now (its screen, not a picture of it) on the computer's clipboard. It needs the guest's program.

ClipboardMenu.console.title.message: Put the text on the guest's text console's screen on your computer's clipboard, as text you can paste in other programs.
ClipboardMenu.console.title.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: tooltip of ClipboardMenu.console.

ClipboardMenu.console.failed.message: The console's text wasn't copied. The guest may have no text console, or this web app ran into a browser limitation.
ClipboardMenu.console.failed.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note after Copy the console's text failed (the guest's program couldn't read the console or didn't answer, or the browser refused the write).

ClipboardMenu.console.graphics.message: The guest's console shows graphics, not text. Copy the screen takes a picture of it instead.
ClipboardMenu.console.graphics.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note after Copy the console's text found the guest's console showing graphics (a desktop runs on it). Copy the screen is ClipboardMenu.screen.

ClipboardMenu.failed.message: Nothing was typed, because this web app couldn't get text from the clipboard.
ClipboardMenu.failed.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note after Type the clipboard found no text (the clipboard had none, or the browser refused).

ClipboardMenu.failed.send.message: Nothing was sent, because this web app couldn't get text or an image from the clipboard.
ClipboardMenu.failed.send.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note after Send the clipboard to the guest found no text and no image (the clipboard had none, or the browser refused).

ClipboardMenu.notText.message: Nothing was typed, because the guest is showing a graphical desktop rather than a text console. Paste with the keyboard while the guest's screen has the focus instead.
ClipboardMenu.notText.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note after Type the clipboard, when the guest's program refused it because a graphical desktop (a compositor) runs on the guest's screen: typed there, the text would wait and run as commands once the desktop ends.

ClipboardMenu.untyped.message: Some of the text wasn't typed, as the guest's console didn't consume all of it.
ClipboardMenu.untyped.note: The toolbar's clipboard menu: a note after Type the clipboard, when the guest's program couldn't type the text, or the program reading the console stopped taking it and the rest was dropped.
